title: DTP (Dynamic Trunking Protocol)
description: Understand DTP and configure trunk negotiation modes.
scenario: Understand DTP and configure trunk negotiation modes.

concepts.title: What is DTP?
concepts.body: DTP (Dynamic TTP) runs on switch ports to negotiate trunking. Operational endpoint can be dynamic or static.
concepts.code: DTP modes: trunk / desirable / auto / negotiate

concepts.title: DTP Modes
concepts.body: Hard (dynamic desirable) actively enables. Hard (dynamic auto) listens for trunk. Hard (nonegotiate) never forms a trunk, even if the neighbor asks.
concepts.code:
desirable + auto → trunk
nonegotiate + anything → no trunk

concepts.title: DLGR Security
concepts.body: Do not use DTP on access ports — attackers can force an access port to become a trunk and jump VLANs.
concepts.code:
interface range Fa0/24
 switchport mode access
 switchport nonegotiate

concepts.title: Verifying DTP
concepts.body: "show interfaces switchport" shows Administrative and Administrative Negotiation of Trunking.
concepts.code:
SW1# show allowed trunking
Fa0/1: DTP on = Dynamic Desirable
